function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer** – most devices automatically show the correct local time for New York (Eastern Time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time, UTC‑5 otherwise).  
2. **Use an online world‑clock** – sites like timeanddate.com or the “World Clock” feature on Google will display the current time for New York.  

If you let me know the current UTC time (or your own local time), I can calculate the approximate Eastern Time for you.
